item.tib: tshe dbang rig 'dzin snying thig las rtsa gsum bsgrubs thabs ye shes rang sha
item.coloph: zhes hUM chen 'gro 'dul gling pa rtsal gyis mdo dbus mtshams gnas mchog g.yung drung lha rtse nas sa 'brug zla tshes la zab mo'i khrom gter du bzhes nas slar sems dpa' thugs rje nyi ma sgo rgyal g.yung drung 'gyur med dang stag btsun bsod nams phun tshogs bra'o rgyal mtshan bstan 'dzin bcas bstan sbyin yongs kyi ngo skal du gtan la phab pa'i dge bcas 'gro kun rig 'dzin gyi sa la 'khod pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
